entities.name: Abuelo
entities.description: Komon Winaq human warrior from Ixalan who died in Topizielo and was summoned as an Echo by Quintorius Kand.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: Cast The Rousing to return Abuelo as an Echo.

entities.name: Mycoids
entities.description: Fungal creatures spreading toward the Core.

entities.name: Mycotyrant
entities.description: Giant fungus that invaded the Core.

events.summary: Abuelo is granted the key to the seal at Matzalantli to protect the Core from the mycoids.
events.quote: Abuelo was granted the key to open the seal at Matzalantli

events.summary: Abuelo dies fighting the mycoids in Topizielo.
events.quote: He later died fighting the mycoids in the Komon city of Topizielo.

events.summary: Quintorius Kand casts The Rousing, returning Abuelo as an Echo.
events.quote: he cast "The Rousing," returning Abuelo as an Echo

events.summary: Abuelo and his wife, also an Echo, help fend off the Mycotyrant until Breeches destroys it.
events.quote: Abuelo and his wife, who was also an Echo, helped fend the mycoids off until Breeches destroyed the giant fungus
